release_notes: Orbitra 2.1.5: Text A/B tests on local offers (same Text A/B tab as local landings, with per-variant traffic share in % and conversion-rate optimization, plus MCP support and schema migration 88); Campaign Rules moved to its own Rules tab in the campaign editor; Conversions log adds a Sources filter & column (traffic_sources_simple) alongside the renamed Landings filter; Unit Economics adds eCPM = (lead/reg + sale/dep revenue) / clicks * 1000 across the Dashboard cards & chart, Reports (general & per-campaign), and Campaigns/Offers/Landings tables. Also fixes Enter inside a text test field submitting the editor form.
